background.description: Deep slate/obsidian (slate-950) for maximum contrast and low eye-strain during operations.

surface.description: slate-900 for solid cards. Glass surfaces MUST use backdrop-blur-xl and a 1px border of slate-800.

primary.description: Signal Blue. Used strictly for primary actions, active states, and AI highlights. No purple or teal gradients.

text.description: slate-50 for primary headings/values, slate-400 for secondary text to maintain clear visual hierarchy.

semantic.description: Crucial for command center triage. Use standard red/amber/green/blue with high saturation to pop against dark backgrounds.

rules: Headings strictly use Outfit. Never use Inter for Headings.
Data metrics should use the 'data_value' scale for high visibility.
Keep line-height loose on body, tight on headings.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid Borders & Density (Mode B: The Control Room Grid)
rules: Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for dashboard grids.
Grid lines should be exposed in analytics sections (border-collapse style).
Apply p-6 or p-8 to cards, keeping breathing room despite data density.
Use 1px borders (border-slate-800) for all cards instead of heavy drop shadows.

patterns.glassmorphism: Used for sticky headers, floating navs, and the Incident Detail Drawer overlay. (bg-slate-950/65 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-800)
patterns.bento_grid: Used for the Executive Overview and Analytics page. Mix span-1 summaries with span-2/3 chart panels.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp edges or max 6px radius (rounded-md). Primary is solid blue, secondary is transparent with slate border.
components.cards: Cardless aesthetic using grid borders OR flat slate-900 cards with 1px border. No soft shadows.
components.charts: Recharts. Use slate-800 for gridlines. Tooltips must have dark glassmorphism backgrounds. Use semantic colors for severity charts.
components.tables: Dense. border-b on rows. Hover state should be extremely subtle (bg-slate-900/50). Clear status pills.
components.badges: Status pills must use soft backgrounds (bg-red-500/10 text-red-500) for elegance, avoiding solid blocks of color.

rules: Micro-interactions only. No heavy bouncy animations.
Hover on interactive cards: -translate-y-[2px] with border color change (border-slate-600).
Drawer slide-in from right for Incident Details.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark mode tech background with glowing structural lines. Use as a subtle background behind the landing page hero section.
Premium geometric grid with subtle blue accent. Good for AI Intelligence center empty states or header banners.
OpenAI Logo. Use in the 'Powered By' or 'Trusted By' section on the landing page.
Samsung Logo. Use in the 'Trusted By' section on the landing page.
Executive portrait 1. Use for Customer Profile or Logged-in Executive User Avatar.
Executive portrait 2. Use in live activity feeds or assignees.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. FRAMEWORK & LIBRARIES: Use React, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, and Shadcn UI. Install @phosphor-icons/react for enterprise-grade iconography.

2. DATA MOCKING: Create a robust mock data layer representing Google Sheets data (customer_name, industry, severity, sentiment, sla_risk, customer_priority_score, escalation_prediction, summary, recommended_action, timestamp).
3. STRUCTURE: Build a public landing page (/) and an authenticated dashboard area (/dashboard). Ensure a global responsive navigation sidebar for the command center.
4. DARK MODE: Force dark mode globally (`<html class='dark'>`). Follow the exact color tokens provided.
5. CHARTS: Implement Recharts for Analytics & Insights. Ensure chart axes, grids, and tooltips are styled for dark mode readability.
6. INTERACTIVITY: Build the Incident Detail Drawer as a side-panel sheet (Shadcn Sheet component).
7. TESTING ATTRIBUTES: MUST add `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case) to all buttons, links, inputs, and major layout sections.
8. POLISH: Use Lucide or Phosphor icons. Ensure tables are properly aligned (numbers right-aligned, text left). Overlays must use the specified glassmorphism pattern.
